name: 51501 · Council Blfs, IA
findings: ZIP 51501 (Council Blfs) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 51501 (Council Blfs) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 51501 (Council Blfs) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).
